description: Logjam security headers — hybrid delivery. Custom CloudFront response headers policies are gated behind the AWS Business plan, so CSP ships via <meta> in the Vite production build, and HTTP-only headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy) come from the AWS-managed `SecurityHeadersPolicy` attached to the frontend distribution.

delivery.csp: Vite plugin in frontend/vite.config.ts injects <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> at build time. Source of truth for the policy string: the CSP_PROD constant in vite.config.ts.
delivery.referrerPolicy: Both the <meta name="referrer"> tag (vite plugin) AND the managed SecurityHeadersPolicy set this. Redundant is fine — same value in both places.
delivery.managedHeaders: Managed policy `SecurityHeadersPolicy` (free, attachable on free tier) provides Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy.

metaCspLimitations: `frame-ancestors` cannot be set via meta — mitigated by managed policy's X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN.
`report-uri` / `report-to` cannot be set via meta — no violation telemetry; rely on browser console during rollout.
Browser applies CSP only after parsing the meta tag, so any resource referenced before the meta tag is not constrained. Vite plugin injects immediately after <head> to minimise this window.
managedPolicyAttachSteps: Response headers policy → dropdown → select `SecurityHeadersPolicy` (under Managed)
verification: Local: `cd frontend && npm run build && grep Content-Security-Policy dist/index.html` — should show meta tag.

Production: open browser DevTools console after deploy. Hit every map basemap, sign in, create a trip log, upload + view a photo and a video, download a GPX/KML, run a topo job, search friends. Any 'Refused to ...' messages indicate a missing allowlist entry.
Production headers: `curl -I https://logjamnsw.com/` should show Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy (from managed CloudFront policy).
notes: Dev server (vite dev) intentionally has NO CSP — HMR uses inline scripts + eval which 'self' would block.
'unsafe-inline' for style-src is required by MUI/emotion runtime style injection. Never relax script-src.
If new tile providers / image hosts are added, update CSP_PROD in frontend/vite.config.ts AND the allowlist in this file.
media-src allows blob: plus awsAssetHosts so uploaded videos (presigned S3 URLs) play inline via <video>; img-src/connect-src already cover photo display + presigned PUT uploads.
geocoderHosts (Nominatim) are connect-src only — used by the map-pick place search (frontend/src/geocode.ts). Only the user-typed place string is sent; no canyon data.
